# `customer_bill_state_change`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

Every state change of a customer bill (ours), oldest first; the first row of a bill is its issue (from_state NULL).

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Primary key, generated by the database (gen_random_uuid()). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | When the row was inserted: the database's now(), not the injected clock. Never used for billing decisions. |
| `customer_bill_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The bill whose state changed. |
| `from_state` | `customer_bill_state_type` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | yes |  | NULL on the bill's issue. |
| `to_state` | `customer_bill_state_type` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | The state it changed to. |
| `changed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When it changed (injected clock). |
| `cause` | `bill_state_change_cause` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | run (issue, settlement in a billing run), payment (settlement of a recorded payment) or operator (hold and release by PATCH). |
| `operator` | `text` | yes |  | The operator from X-Remote-User for cause operator (display only); else NULL. |
